reason: README provides clear user-facing behavior: a DSH browser plugin for chat composer visibility and placement during scroll interactions, plus synchronized back-to-bottom float positioning, which is primarily a layout/UI experience enhancement.

summaries.zh: 该插件面向 DSH 浏览器聊天界面，在滚动消息时自动隐藏或恢复输入条，并同步“返回底部”浮动按钮的位置，以减少历史记录阅读时的遮挡。
summaries.en: This plugin is a DSH browser chat UI enhancement that automatically hides or restores the composer while scrolling and keeps the back-to-bottom float in sync to reduce obstruction when reading message history.

capabilities: Hides and repositions the composer input bar based on scroll position.
Adjusts a CSS custom property so the back-to-bottom float tracks the composer position.
Uses passive scroll event handling with requestAnimationFrame-throttled updates.

reasons.code: Describes itself as a browser-side plugin that makes the composer follow message flow while scrolling.
Features include composer sliding off-screen when scrolling up and returning near bottom on back-to-latest navigation.
Repository description and README explicitly target DSH UI composition input bar behavior.
